images.title: 186 passes the tests for 2 and 3
images.purpose: Shows that a number divisible by 2 and by 3 is divisible by 6, using 186.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no characters, no extra text. The number on top, two branches below for the two tests, joining into one result box.
images.exact_structure: At the top centre, large: 186. Two thin dark arrows go down to two boxes side by side. Left box, teal (#0072B2) outline: units digit 6, with divisible by 2 under it. Right box, amber (#E69F00) outline: digit sum 15, with divisible by 3 under it. Two arrows from the boxes join into one reddish purple (#CC79A7) box at the bottom centre holding 186 = 6 × 31. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: 186 passes the test for 2 and the test for 3, so it is divisible by 6.
images.description: Shows that a number divisible by 2 and by 3 is divisible by 6, using 186.

image_decisions.why: Two tests joining into one result shows how divisibility by 6 is checked through 2 and 3.
